'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] have begun an anticipated [[military offensive]] in the [[Donbas]] with explosions reported in multiple cities. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-61145578 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russia-launches-new-eastern-offensive-with-blasts-all-along-front-2022-04-19/ (Reuters)]
***[[War in Donbas]]
****A civilian is killed and several others are injured by an explosion in [[Kramatorsk]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/four-killed-as-shells-fall-on-kharkiv-homes/ (''Times of Israel'')]
***[[Nuclear threats during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Amidst American allegations that [[Russia]] may use [[nuclear weapon|nuclear weapons]], [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] says that the country will not use them and will continue using [[Conventional weapon|conventional weapons]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-ukraine-nuclear-weapons-sergei-lavrov-1698909 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[Iron Dome]] intercepts a [[Hamas]] missile fired into [[Southern District (Israel)|Israel's Southern District]] from the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/rocket-fired-from-gaza-intercepted-over-southern-border-communities-idf/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**[[Israel]] fires missiles at a Hamas weapon depot in Gaza in response to the Hamas attack. No injuries are reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/sirens-blast-heard-near-israel-gaza-border-possible-rocket-interception-2022-04-18/ (Reuters)]
**At least 40 [[Palestinians]] are injured after the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] fires tear gas and rubber bullets at Palestinians protesting a march held by [[right-wing]] settlers near the former [[Israeli settlement|settlement]] of [[Homesh]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/19/palestinians-injured-after-israeli-settlers-march-outpost (Al Jazeera)]
*[[April 2022 Kabul school bombing|2022 Kabul school bombing]]
**At least six people are killed and many others are injured by a school bombing in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blasts-hit-kabul-high-school-causing-casualties-2022-04-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Sri Lankan protests]]
**One person is killed and 14 others injured after [[Sri Lanka Police|police]] fire live bullets at protesters in [[Rambukkana]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-61151037 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A tractor collides with a military vehicle in [[South Darfur]], [[Sudan]], killing five people. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/traffic-accident-carnage-in-sudan (''Radio Dabanga'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[International reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian foreign ministry]] expels 21 [[Foreign relations of Belgium|Belgian diplomats]], 15 [[Foreign relations of the Netherlands|Dutch diplomats]] and 4 [[Foreign relations of Austria|Austrian diplomats]] as a reciprocal measure. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/04/19/russia-says-expelling-36-european-diplomats-a77409 (''The Moscow Times'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-expels-4-austrian-diplomats-in-tit-for-tat-move/2567630 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Greece]] seizes Russian-flagged [[oil tanker]] ''Pegas/Lana'' off the island of [[Euboea]] as part of [[European Union]] [[economic sanctions]] on Russia. The ship had 19 crew members on board, according to the [[Ministry of Shipping and Island Policy (Greece)|Ministry of Shipping]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-seizes-russian-tanker-part-eu-sanctions-2022-04-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran–Israel relations]], [[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Iranian president]] [[Ebrahim Raisi]] warns [[government of Israel|Israel]] that Iran will respond to any hostile action taken against it. [https://dw.com/en/iran-warns-israel-against-hostile-military-action/a-61505742 (DW)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/18/iran-warns-israel-national-army-day (Al Jazeera)]
*[[China–Solomon Islands relations]]
**The [[Foreign minister|foreign ministers]] of the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China|People's Republic of China]] and [[Foreign relations of Solomon Islands|Solomon Islands]] sign a security pact. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/19/china-says-it-has-signed-security-pact-with-solomon-islands (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Cameroon–Russia relations]]
**''[[Jeune Afrique]]'' reports that on [[Portal:Current events/2022 April 12|12 April]] the [[Defence minister|defence ministers]] of [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russia]] and [[Cameroon]] signed a new military cooperation agreement, renewing a similar agreement signed in 2015. [https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1340317/politique/cameroun-russie-vers-un-rapprochement-militaire-entre-yaounde-et-moscou/ (''Jeune Afrique'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 East Timorese presidential election]]
**The [[East Timor]]ese people head to the polls for the second round of the presidential election between [[José Ramos-Horta]] and incumbent [[Francisco Guterres]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/19/timor-lestes-presidential-election-ramos-horta-and-lu-olo-guterres?CMP=twt_a-world_b-gdnworld (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[United States]] says it will ban [[anti-satellite missile]] tests. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-61151141 (BBC News)]
